Name: Industrialization Redux Expanded
Author: Charost
Description:
[b][size=5]English[/size][/b]
[spoiler][color=#D4D4D8][b][size=5]If you notice some mods only add recipes for the original machines and not for the advanced machines in Industrialization Redux, feel free to point it out![/size][/b]

This mod supplements recipes for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22351]Industrialization Redux[/url]. It focuses on compatibility patches with other mods and makes no changes to [b]Industrialization Redux[/b]'s vanilla content.

If you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/541]Lookup Anything[/url] , you can view all recipes for the relevant machines. Due to unavoidable constraints, two similar‑function machines may not display identical recipes, yet they are intended to produce equivalent in‑game results!

For parameters such as processing time and output stack size, [b]Industrialization Redux advanced machines should halve processing duration and support up to 5‑times the input capacity compared to vanilla‑style machines[/b]. Please report any recipes that fail to follow this rule.

[b][size=4]Known Issues[/size][/b]
Due to limitations of the Extra Machine Config (EMC) framework, recipe logic of the form [b]below cannot be implemented[/b]:
k (x InputA + y InputB  ⇌  z OutputC + l OutputD)
Only this form is achievable:
kx InputA + y InputB  ⇌  kz OutputC + l OutputD

For every recipe with multiple inputs or multiple outputs, scaling multipliers only apply to the [b]primary input and primary output[/b]. Secondary inputs and secondary outputs are coded to a count of 1.
This situation occurs frequently for recipes from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27049]Wildflour's Atelier Goods[/url]. There is no clean, performant workaround at present [s](a brute‑force inefficient workaround exists)[/s]. Please do not submit bug reports for this limitation.[/color][/spoiler]


[b][size=5]中文[/size][/b]
[spoiler][b][size=5]如果你发现一些mod只为原版机器添加了配方而没有为
Industrialization Redux 的相关高级机器添加，欢迎指出！[/size][/b]

为 [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22351]Industrialization Redux[/url] 进行配方补充，此mod主要用于优化 [b]Industrialization Redux[/b] 与其他mod的兼容性，不会对 [b]Industrialization Redux[/b] 本身的内容进行更新。

如果你拥有 [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/541]Lookup Anything[/url] ，你可以看到所有相关机器的配方。不过由于不可抗力的原因，两个相似的机器所展示的配方未必完全一样，但它们实现的效果应该是一样的！

在部分问题上，例如产出时间和产物数量，  [b]Industrialization Redux [/b]的高级机器相比原版机器应当只需花费一半的处理时间并且最多进行五倍的进给。如果你发现有配方不满足，欢迎指出。

[size=4][b]已知问题[/b][/size]
由于EMC框架原因，无法实现形如下述表达式的配方
k (x 输入A + y 输入B  [b]⇌[/b]  z 输出C + l 输出D)
只能实现这样的
kx 输入A + y 输入B  [b]⇌[/b]  kz 输出C + l 输出D
所以，对于所有拥有多输入或多输出的配方，仅有主输入输出的数量满足要求，副输入和副输出通常被我设定为1个。
这点多出现在 [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27049]Wildflour's Atelier Goods[/url] 中，这暂时没有高效的解决方式[s]（但其实有低效的解决方式）[/s]，请不要反应此问题。[/spoiler]
